description_en: Gets a paginated list of commit statuses
description_zh: 查询提交状态列表，支持分页
name: ListCommitStatuses

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can obtain the ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. The URL is in the format `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) credentials to authenticate your identity
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The commit ID. You must provide the SHA value of the commit
parameters.name: sha

parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description_en: The root object of the response

context.description_en: A string that identifies the system that created the status. The string is displayed as a title in the UI. The default value is `default`. The value is case-insensitive and must be 50 characters or less
context.description_zh: 用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

creator.description_en: Details about the user or application that created the commit status
creator.description_zh: 提交状态的写入人简要信息

aliyunPk.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. This parameter is empty if the value of `type` is `Bot`
aliyunPk.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID，若type=Bot时，则为空

login.description_en: The login name. If `type` is `User`, this parameter indicates the username. If `type` is `Bot`, this parameter indicates the application name
login.description_zh: 若type=User，则为用户名；若type=Bot，则为应用名

type.description_en:
The type of the creator. Valid values:

`User`: a regular user

`Bot`: an application
type.description_zh:
写入人类型

User：普通用户类型
Bot：应用类型

description.description_en: A brief description of the commit status. The description must be 3,000 characters or less
description.description_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符

id.description_en: The ID of the status. This ID is for internal use only

state.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

`error`: An error occurred.

`failure`: The operation failed.

`pending`: The operation is in progress.

`success`: The operation was successful
state.description_zh:
写入状态

error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功

targetUrl.description_en: The target URL for the status. The UI includes a link to this URL. You can point this to a third-party system
targetUrl.description_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`

`false`
success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功

false：失败

total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
